extractionDecision.target: Skill-bundled Vue component baseline for PM, UI, AI and development work
extractionDecision.currentEffect: Skill Vue reference library only; no UAT or product source change

skillLibraryImplementation.projectEffect: none; product shared Vue source and consumer migration not started

skillVueLibrary.scope: PM prototypes, AI generated pages, development requirements and engineering handoff

stageDefinitions.A: page-local candidate pattern, not a shared component
stageDefinitions.B: incubating design component with real reuse evidence
stageDefinitions.C: stable design component and default reuse entry

components.name: LeadScoreRuleTable
components.task: edit additive and subtractive lead scoring rules
components.promotionCondition: a second lead-domain rule page shares row semantics, editing model and confirmation flow
components.antiPattern: promote it to Common only because it visually resembles a table

components.name: KnowledgeUploadPanel
components.task: upload knowledge material and show task progress and result
components.promotionCondition: another GEO page shares file constraints, task lifecycle and retry semantics
components.antiPattern: merge unrelated import flows only because they all contain a drop zone

components.name: ContentPageHeader
components.task: identify the current page from its top-left page-level heading and expose page-level status and primary actions
locked: exactly one top-left ContentPageHeader per independent page
fixed icon plus main title plus subtitle structure
subtitle aligns to the component left edge
page name is the only h1
module headings use SectionHeader and h2/h3
reuse the verified existing project mapping without page-local restyling
components.promotionCondition: shared Vue implementation is consumed across two business domains and passes wide/squeezed review
components.antiPattern: missing or duplicated page header, page-specific title DOM, custom marker dialects or duplicated outer margin

components.name: MetricGrid
components.task: present a comparable KPI summary with responsive equal-height cards
components.promotionCondition: MetricCard and grid become shared Vue components across two business domains without business flags
components.antiPattern: isGmv/isTraffic/isLead switches or arbitrary KPI class dialects

components.name: SectionCard
components.task: group one coherent business section with title, description, actions and body
components.promotionCondition: shared Vue component supports representative list and dashboard consumers without layout branching
components.antiPattern: one generic card with page-specific boolean props

components.name: ChartPanel
components.task: frame a chart with title, time or scope, legend space and feedback states
locked: chart resize after content width change
empty/error not drawn as fake data
components.promotionCondition: shared Vue shell handles ECharts lifecycle and Agent squeeze across two business domains
components.antiPattern: hide chart lifecycle and business option inside one oversized component

components.name: TimeRangeFilter
components.task: change the time range or period for the current page data scope
components.promotionCondition: period semantics and event contract are shared across two business domains
components.antiPattern: reuse the same visual control when period semantics or timezone behavior differ

components.name: SectionHeader
components.task: identify a repeatable top-level business module inside the current content page
locked: repeatable module heading, not page heading
components.promotionCondition: shared Vue implementation is consumed by representative dashboard, chart and list modules without page-specific heading dialects
components.antiPattern: second h1, copied ContentPageHeader, business-colored markers or heavy SectionHeader repeated for subsection labels

components.name: ActionButton
components.task: trigger primary, secondary, danger or compact actions
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed

components.name: FormControl
components.task: enter or select business filter and form values
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: placeholder as the only persistent field name

components.name: StatusTag
components.task: communicate business status without relying on color alone
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: same status uses different colors across pages

components.name: FeedbackNotice
components.task: show page-level warning, permission, sync or error context
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: use a large saturated card as ordinary decoration

components.name: ContentTabs
components.task: switch stable views of the same data task inside the content slot
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: reuse content tabs as Topbar static or AI result tabs

components.name: ListSurface
components.task: keep toolbar, data table and pagination as one continuous data surface
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: split toolbar, table and pagination into unrelated page-level cards

components.name: FilterBar
components.task: filter one data set without mixing page actions or table actions into the same semantic row
sourcePages: list, summary-list and dashboard detail templates
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
locked: 36px controls when used as ordinary page form
query and reset semantics remain explicit
components.antiPattern: mix page primary actions, row actions and filters into one undifferentiated toolbar

components.name: DataTable
components.task: scan and act on structured records with predictable density and alignment
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
components.antiPattern: invent page-specific row heights or let the whole page scroll horizontally

components.name: Pagination
components.task: navigate a bounded record set while preserving active filters and count context
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
locked: belongs to the same ListSurface as its data
every KPI/time/status filter change resets to page 1
components.antiPattern: detach pagination from the data surface or keep an invalid page after filters change

components.name: FeedbackState
components.task: replace the normal content region with a clear loading, empty, filtered-empty, error or no-permission state and an appropriate recovery action
sourcePages: list, dashboard, task and form templates
components.acceptanceStatus: stable skill contract; project implementation mixed
locked: no fake data in empty/error states
one relevant recovery action at most
does not replace FeedbackNotice for non-blocking context
components.antiPattern: use one generic no-data message for loading, permission, error and filtered-empty states
